item.title: Lagos: Police arrest 114 suspects for defilement, 24 for sexual assault in 2025
item.description: The Gender Unit of the Lagos State Police Command has apprehended 114 suspects over cases of defilement and arrested an additional 24 individuals for sexual assault by penetration between January 1 and December 1, 2025. Official records reviewed indicate that the unit handled 18 cases within the period, all of which have been concluded and […] Lagos: Police arrest 114 suspects for defilement, 24 for sexual assault in 2025

item.title: Tinubu orders deployment of army battalion to Kwara after deadly Kaiama attack
item.description: President Bola Tinubu has ordered the immediate deployment of an army battalion to Kaiama Local Government Area of Kwara State following a deadly overnight attack on Worro community by suspected Boko Haram terrorists. The directive, which also includes the appointment of a field commander and the immediate commencement of a military operation tagged Operation Savanna […] Tinubu orders deployment of army battalion to Kwara after deadly Kaiama attack

item.title: NNPCL explains move to revamp Port Harcourt, other refineries months after shutdown
item.description: The Group Chief Executive Officer of NNPC Ltd, Engr. Bashir Bayo Ojulari, has explained that the company is currently in talks with partners in order to build sustainable, self-financing, and profitable solutions for the Port Harcourt, Warri, and Kaduna state-owned refineries. item.title: Transfer: Super Eagles defender moves to Libyan club Al Shomooa
item.description: Super Eagles defender, Olisa Ndah has joined Libyan outfit, Al Shomooa, DAILY POST reports. Ndah moved on a free transfer after severing ties with South African giants Orlando Pirates late last month. The centre-back signed a one-half-year deal with Al Shomooa. The 28-year-old linked up with Pirates from Nigeria Premier Football League, NPFL, outfit, Akwa […] Transfer: Super Eagles defender moves to Libyan club Al Shomooa

item.title: Lagos: Traders seek Nigerian govt intervention over demolition of spare parts market
item.description: Traders at the Owode-Onirin Motor Spare Parts Market in Lagos State have appealed to the Federal Government to intervene in, and thoroughly investigate, the demolition of their market, which they alleged was deliberately carried out by the Lagos State Government in what they described as a high-level conspiracy. item.title: Osun LG crisis: Police confirm five arrests as bereaved families seek justice
item.description: The Nigeria Police have confirmed the detention of five suspects linked to last year’s deadly violence surrounding disputes over local government control in Osun State, as relatives of those killed renewed calls for prosecution. The arrests follow investigations into the fatal shooting of Segun Oloyede and Taiwo Oyebamiji during clashes in Iragbiji on February 17, […] Osun LG crisis: Police confirm five arrests as bereaved families seek justice
